title: Human Capital Hegemony
target_metric: Highest collective Loyalty Points [LOY] across your living and dead roster (min 1 required).
rules_text: Endgame Audit Target Metric: Highest collective [LOY] across your living and dead roster (minimum [1 LOY] required to qualify). 1st Place: [+15 VP] | 2nd Place: [+10 VP] | 3rd Place: [+5 VP].

art_spec.visual_description: A towering holographic wall of honor inside a corporate headquarters displaying decorated veteran operatives and glowing royal-blue loyalty chevrons.
art_spec.art_style: Near-future gritty corporate sci-fi concept art, hard-surface industrial design, matte digital illustration with dramatic rim lighting.

body:
# Human Capital Hegemony

* **Ideological Mandate:** Cultivate the most prestigious, highly indoctrinated veteran personnel in the Agency.
* **Target Metric:** Highest collective **Loyalty Points ([LOY])** across your living and dead roster *(minimum [1 LOY] required to qualify)*.

## Tiered Endgame Scoring

| Standing | Reward Payout |
| :--- | :--- |
| **1st Place (Most [LOY])** | **[+15 VP]** |
| **2nd Place (2nd Most [LOY])** | **[+10 VP]** |
| **3rd Place (3rd Most [LOY])** | **[+5 VP]** |

> **Tie Resolution:** Tied Factions each claim the full VP reward for that rank, and the next rank down is skipped.
